tools.description: Scans Python and HTML files under /testbed for a case-insensitive text substring and returns file:line excerpts. This helps locate implementation code without requiring a shell, grep, or network access.
tools.label: Search repository source text
tools.name: source_text_search

max_results.description: Maximum number of matches to return (1-200, default 30).

query.description: Text to search for in repository source files. Case-insensitive substring matching is used.

scope.description: Optional directory under /testbed to restrict the search, e.g. django/forms.
